name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.helly
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (x : ℕ → ℤ_[l]) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ a b, ‖x a - x b‖ ≤ max (r a) (r b)) →
∃ s : ℤ_[l], ∀ a, ‖s - x a‖ ≤ r a := by
((Set.univ : Set ℤ_[l]) ∩ ⋂ a ∈ u, Metric.closedBall (x a) (r a)).Nonempty := by
· obtain ⟨a0, ha0, hmin⟩ := u.exists_min_image r hu
exact (hx a0 a).trans (max_le (hmin a ha) le_rfl)
(fun a => Metric.closedBall (x a) (r a)) (fun a => Metric.isClosed_closedBall) hne
assume: Assume `(∀ a b, ‖x a - x b‖ ≤ max (r a) (r b))` (hx).
show: Let ℓ be prime. For a sequence of ℓ-adic integers xₐ and real radii rₐ, suppose the distance between any two centres is at most the larger radius. Then there is an ℓ-adic integer s with distance at most rₐ from every xₐ.
strategy: In each nonempty finite family choose a ball of smallest radius. Its centre lies in all the balls of the family. Compactness of the ℓ-adic integers gives a point in the countable intersection.

steps.claim: Write $B_a$ for the closed ball about $x_a$ with radius $r_a$. Every finite intersection of the $B_a$ is nonempty, since a centre of minimal radius belongs to all the balls in any nonempty finite family.
steps.snippet:
have hne : ∀ u : Finset ℕ,
      ((Set.univ : Set ℤ_[l]) ∩ ⋂ a ∈ u, Metric.closedBall (x a) (r a)).Nonempty := by
    intro u
steps.typedFact:
∀ u : Finset ℕ,
      ((Set.univ : Set ℤ_[l]) ∩ ⋂ a ∈ u, Metric.closedBall (x a) (r a)).Nonempty

children.claim: An empty set of indices imposes no conditions, while a nonempty finite set has an index at which the radius is minimal.
If $u$ is empty, the intersection is all of $\mathbf Z_\ell$, so $0$ belongs to it.
For nonempty $u$ choose $a_0\in u$ minimizing $r_a$. For every $a\in u$, the assumed bound gives $\lVert x_{a_0}-x_a\rVert\le\max(r_{a_0},r_a)=r_a$, so $x_{a_0}$ belongs to every selected ball.
children.snippet:
· obtain ⟨a0, ha0, hmin⟩ := u.exists_min_image r hu
      refine ⟨x a0, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      intro a ha
      exact (hx a0 a).trans (max_le (hmin a ha) le_rfl)

steps.claim: The $B_a$ are closed in compact $\mathbf Z_\ell$ and have the finite intersection property. Compactness gives $s\in\bigcap_a B_a$, which says $\lVert s-x_a\rVert\le r_a$ for every $a$.
steps.snippet:
obtain ⟨s, -, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.inter_iInter_nonempty
    (fun a => Metric.closedBall (x a) (r a)) (fun a => Metric.isClosed_closedBall) hne
  refine ⟨s, fun a => ?_⟩
  have h1 := Set.mem_iInter.1 hs a
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at h1
  exact h1

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
